verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a dedicated Sandbox with its own credentials. In it you can safely simulate payments, check API behavior and trigger webhooks without processing real transactions, and you can force payment outcomes by passing status codes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, explicit documentation of how sandbox data is kept separate from production data within the shared account.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Log in and start testing our products in the Sandbox using the credentials provided in the Integration section.
It allows you to safely simulate payments, check API behavior, and trigger webhooks without processing real transactions.
In Sandbox, you can control the payment result by passing a status code in the request body's `description` field.
You can manage both sandbox and production from the same account.
